svg.title: ParkRead Sweden, reading a no-parking zone sign
svg.desc: The reading of a no-parking zone sign scrolls from top to bottom and back: from the selected start time the timeline says no parking; who can park here says the sign marks the start of a no-parking area; and what was read lists the zone sign as the primary sign and the operator plate and two road signs as not parking rules, with a caution that no plate states a parking rule.
